escalations.why: risk.Drawdown in docs/packages/risk/contract.md is 'ticker: str; depth: float; peak_date: str', but RISK-05 (docs/spec.md:34) requires the trough date too, TC-08 (tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json) expects a trough_date per ticker, and M1-T20's acceptance is 'depth within 1e-12, both dates exact'. Freezing Drawdown as written would block M1-T20 in this milestone. Proposed: add 'trough_date: str' (invariant: trough_date >= peak_date; both the first date when there is no fall), then re-run M1-T01.
